series.name: Agent Day 1 — The First Door
series.description: Required agent and hire orientation: operating law, doors, trust, readiness note — then TR-001A and seed path.

series.name: Agent Day 2 — Finding the Source of Truth
series.description: Required verification training: authority ladder, truth labels, source checks, conflicts, evidence packets.

series.name: Agent Day 3 — From Signal to Action
series.description: Flagship AVCC judgment training: signal-to-action brief, priority filter, executive brief format.

series.name: Agent Day 4 — The Handoff Is the Work
series.description: Handoff discipline: Trail System, Handoff Packet, EOD Capsule, state-update discipline.

series.name: Agent Day 5 — Working the Queue
series.description: Learn queue triage without open-front chaos — P1/P2/P3, active/blocked/parked states, intake filter, One-Action Rule, and Queue Triage Card.

series.name: Agent Day 6 — Safe Access & Boundaries
series.description: Protect trust while working with roles, identity, authorization, scope, environments, public/private surfaces, and access incidents.

series.name: Agent Day 7 — Builder & Client Experience
series.description: Help builders, clients, and prospects with the smallest complete answer — expose, summarize, or withhold internal detail appropriately.

series.name: Agent Day 8 — Writing Like AeroVista
series.description: Produce docs, briefs, scripts, and messages that guide action — audience-aware, bounded, and grounded in evidence.

series.name: Agent Day 9 — From Draft to Deliverable
series.description: Define done, prevent scope creep, verify acceptance criteria, polish in order, and package work as a usable deliverable.

series.name: Agent Day 10 — Trusted Agent Capstone
series.description: Capstone readiness gate: integrate Days 1–9 into judgment, boundaries, momentum, and a Trusted Agent Readiness Brief before supervised live work.

series.name: Infographic Training
series.description: Image-first overlay lessons built from the infographic source pack.

series.name: AV Apparel Onboarding
series.description: Three-episode onboarding lane for apparel culture, catalog work, and operating standards.

series.name: The Art Localized
series.description: Five-episode creative collaboration and partnership training lane.

series.name: Contributor Onboarding
series.description: Hub plus five supporting episodes for contributor expectations, lanes, and readiness.

series.name: Lumina Revenue Lane
series.description: Six-episode Lumina revenue series that leads into the revenue routing mission.

series.name: Shareholder Season 1 — Briefing Series
series.description: Legacy audio-synced briefing players for shareholder narrative (S1-EP-01 through S1-EP-06). Side lane — not Day 1 onboarding.

series.name: Internal Recap
